				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>LIVE LIKE A LOCAL<span class="s2"><b>▽</b></span></h3>
<p><span style="color: #808080;"><em>And follow our salty routine: </em></span></p>
<div class="wildk-home-enjoy-our-3-kite-clubs__item">
<p><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7" data-lazy-type="image" data-lazy-src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3.png" width="188" height="187" alt="" class="lazy lazy-hidden wp-image-15741 alignnone size-full" data-lazy-srcset="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3.png 188w, https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3-150x150.png 150w" data-lazy-sizes="(max-width: 188px) 100vw, 188px" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async"  width="188" height="187" alt=""  data-srcset="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3.png 188w, https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3-150x150.png 150w"  data-src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3.png" data-sizes="(max-width: 188px) 100vw, 188px" class="wp-image-15741 alignnone size-full lazyload" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3.png" width="188" height="187" alt="" class="wp-image-15741 alignnone size-full" srcset="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3.png 188w, https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/admin-ajax_new.php_-3-150x150.png 150w" sizes="(max-width: 188px) 100vw, 188px" /></noscript></noscript></p>
<div class="time-pill2">6:00 &#8211; 11:00</div>
<p><span style="color: #333333;"><b>Surf or do yoga on windless mornings.</b></span><br />Before or after an Olympian breakfast. Or, try one of the various windless activities or tours we have for you <a href="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/13-awesome-activities-to-do-in-mancora-peru/">here</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="wildk-home-enjoy-our-3-kite-clubs__item">
<p><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7" data-lazy-type="image" data-lazy-src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/breeze_new.png-3-300x300.webp" width="300" height="300" alt="" class="lazy lazy-hidden wp-image-15745 alignnone size-medium" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async"  width="300" height="300" alt=""  data-src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/breeze_new.png-3-300x300.webp" class="wp-image-15745 alignnone size-medium lazyload" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/breeze_new.png-3-300x300.webp" width="300" height="300" alt="" class="wp-image-15745 alignnone size-medium" /></noscript></noscript></p>
<div class="time-pill2">11:00 &#8211; 17:30</div>
<p><span style="color: #333333;"><b>Kitesurfing in the afternoon.</b></span><br />Thermal winds begin to blow around noon. Depending on your level, you can take <a title="Kiteboarding Lessons" href="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/kitesurf-school-mancora/">kite lessons</a>, go free riding, go wing foiling on the main spot, or go foiling in front of our club down the coast. Another option is joining our guide aboard our Land Cruiser for an epic <a title="Wave Kitesurf Camp" href="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/kitesurf-wave-camp/" target="_blank" rel="noopener">wave kite surfari or downwinder!</a></p>
</div>
<div class="wildk-home-enjoy-our-3-kite-clubs__item">
<p><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAIAAAAAAAP///yH5BAEAAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAIBRAA7" data-lazy-type="image" data-lazy-src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3.webp" width="174" height="174" alt="" class="lazy lazy-hidden wp-image-15749 alignnone size-full" data-lazy-srcset="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3.webp 174w, https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3-150x150.webp 150w" data-lazy-sizes="(max-width: 174px) 100vw, 174px" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async"  width="174" height="174" alt=""  data-srcset="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3.webp 174w, https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3-150x150.webp 150w"  data-src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3.webp" data-sizes="(max-width: 174px) 100vw, 174px" class="wp-image-15749 alignnone size-full lazyload" src="data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAAAAACH5BAEKAAEALAAAAAABAAEAAAICTAEAOw==" /><noscript><img loading="lazy" loading="lazy" decoding="async" src="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3.webp" width="174" height="174" alt="" class="wp-image-15749 alignnone size-full" srcset="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3.webp 174w, https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/sunset-gathering_new.png-3-150x150.webp 150w" sizes="(max-width: 174px) 100vw, 174px" /></noscript></noscript></p>
<div class="time-pill2">6:00 &#8211; 22:00</div>
<p><span style="color: #333333;"><b>Sunset gatherings.</b></span><br />Do you still have enough energy for a late yoga or surf session? Alternately, skip to the part where you can enjoy a beer (or a Kombucha) with our friendly community. Then you can go downtown, visit one of the numerous tempting restaurants, or opt for an early sleep. 🤙</p>
</div></div>
			</div>
			</div>
			</div><div class="et_pb_row et_pb_row_6 full-width-row wildk-row-image-right-text-left et_animated et_pb_equal_columns et_pb_gutters1">
				<div class="et_pb_column et_pb_column_1_2 et_pb_column_10  et_pb_css_mix_blend_mode_passthrough">
				<div class="et_pb_module et_pb_text et_pb_text_10  et_pb_text_align_left et_pb_bg_layout_light">
				<div class="et_pb_text_inner"><h3>IKO CERTIFIED KITE SCHOOL</h3>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Wild Kite Peru is the only <a href="https://www.ikointl.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener" title="International Kiteboarding Organization">IKO</a> certified Kiteboarding school in Mancora and the northern part of Peru.</p>
<p>The IKO certification gives you a guarantee of quality in terms of kite lessons and safety assurances. On top of that, we’ll certify your initiation, allowing you to rent or continue your learning process in any other IKO kite school worldwide.</p>
<p style="text-align: right;"><a class="wildk-btn wildk-btn-rounded wildk-btn-outline-over-white" href="https://wild-kitesurf-peru.com/kitesurf-school-mancora/">Learn Kiteboarding Here</a></p></div>
			</div>

<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>Stay with us in <a href="https://www.instagram.com/lamaison.mancora/">La Maison</a> <span style="font-weight: 400;">our boutique Eco-House lodging in Mancora, a hidden oasis with </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">rad</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> music, health</span><span style="font-weight: 400;">y</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> breakfasts, the best coffee in town, and </span><span style="font-weight: 400;">especially:</span><span style="font-weight: 400;"> the nicest people. </span></p>
